title: F. Build XOR on a Segment
statement:
You are given an array of $$n$$ integers $$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$, where all numbers are from $$1$$ to $$2^{12} - 1$$.

You have to process $$q$$ queries. Each query is defined by three integers $$l_i, r_i, x_i$$: you need to find the smallest set $$S = \{s_1, s_2, \dots, s_k\}$$ that satisfies the following conditions:

The first line contains one integer $$n$$ ($$2 $\leq n \leq 10^4$$$).

The second line contains $$n$$ integers $$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$ ($$1 $\leq a_i \leq 2^{12} - 1$$$).

The third line contains one integer $$q$$ ($$1 $\leq q \leq 10^6$$$).

Then $$q$$ lines follow. The $$i$$-th of them contains three integers $$l_i, r_i, x_i$$ ($$1 $\leq l_i \leq r_i \leq n$$$; $$1 $\leq x_i \leq 2^{12} - 1$$$).

For each query, print one integer — the minimum size of the required set. If such a set does not exist, print $$0$$.

Consider the queries from the example:
input: Input The first line contains one integer $$n$$ ($$2 $\leq n \leq 10^4$$$). The second line contains $$n$$ integers $$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$ ($$1 $\leq a_i \leq 2^{12} - 1$$$). The third line contains one integer $$q$$ ($$1 $\leq q \leq 10^6$$$). Then $$q$$ lines follow. The $$i$$-th of them contains three integers $$l_i, r_i, x_i$$ ($$1 $\leq l_i \leq r_i \leq n$$$; $$1 $\leq x_i \leq 2^{12} - 1$$$).
output: Output For each query, print one integer — the minimum size of the required set. If such a set does not exist, print $$0$$.
